entries.title: Repost and quote posts
entries.description: Share a post as it is or add your own words with a quote post. Reposts show up in feeds and profiles, and you get a notification when someone shares yours.

entries.title: Download your data or delete your account
entries.description: From settings, you can now download a copy of your personal data or delete your Orbis account.

entries.title: See the edit history of posts and comments
entries.description: Posts, comments, and forum posts that were edited now let you open a history of their earlier versions.

entries.title: Direct messages on mobile
entries.description: Your inbox is now in the mobile app, with direct conversations, message requests, and messages that arrive as they're sent.

entries.title: Friends and live status on mobile
entries.description: Search for people, manage friend requests, set your status, and see who's online from the mobile app.

entries.title: Create and manage communities on mobile
entries.description: You can now start a community and change its settings from your phone if you're an admin.

entries.title: Community invites on mobile
entries.description: Create and manage invites for your communities, and join one by opening an invite link or QR code.

entries.title: Community switcher and member lists on mobile
entries.description: Move between your communities with a switcher that keeps your folders and order in sync. You can also browse members and set your nickname and library sharing for each community.

entries.title: Rich posts and title discussions on mobile
entries.description: Posts and comments now show rich content and link previews on mobile, and you can join the discussions on a title's page.

entries.title: A fuller home feed on mobile
entries.description: The mobile home feed now works much more like the one on the web, and it remembers your feed preferences.

entries.title: Steam library stays up to date
entries.description: Your Steam library now syncs when you come online and after you finish playing a game, so your games and hours stay current.
